deviations: Hmisc/memisc 'labelled'/'.item' column classes were stripped to plain vectors (memisc is not installed); numeric memisc items such as diplome4 and taille_agglo therefore enter as numeric regressors.
notes: Followed papier.R: Table 4 = reg_effect_feedback_1..4 (weighted lm, subset variante_taxe_info=='f' [& |simule_gain|<50]); Table 6 col 1 = manual 2SLS tsls1_si1/tsls2_si1 on the [p10,p60] subsample, instruments traite_cible*traite_cible_conjoint; Table 8 col 1 = manual 2SLS tsls1_ee1/tsls2_ee1, instruments apres_modifs + info_CC. Data from after_preparation.RData (as papier.R loads); control-name vectors rebuilt with piece.formula/variables_demo and checked identical to those stored in after_papier.RData. Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (attempt 1 crashed on a memisc class lookup while printing classes). Attempt 3 crashed on the same issue and was repaired. The final run's values were compared by eye with the claims; all round to the claimed values and no change followed, so there is no claim attempt.
